## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile-supported 3D-style gore shooter game with blood effects.

## Requirements
- User requested: “A 3D gore shooting game mobile support with good gore and blood dripping”.
- Build the game now without asking questions; note assumptions briefly at completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game using Canvas-based pseudo-3D rather than external 3D libraries.
- Used stylized monsters, blood splashes/drips, and corridor survival gameplay.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive game page with title screen, HUD, corridor scene, enemy waves, score/best score, health, ammo/reload, pause, and mobile fire/joystick controls.
- Added shooting, enemy damage/kills, particle gore effects, blood stains, and desktop/mobile input handling.
- Fixed CSS parsing that prevented styles after the overlay rule from applying.
- Fixed enemy orientation and moved the pause button to avoid HUD overlap.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/gameplay.jpg`; gameplay renders with corridor, enemies, and HUD.
- Verified shots reduce ammo and register hits.

### Active
- Finish the small UI polish change in `game.js` related to title/pause/end-game state and joystick knob positioning; then recheck.
- Review final changes and report assumptions briefly.

- (none)

1. Add joystick-knob `transform` using `--x`/`--y` and set both variables in `moveJoy`.

3. Check `git status` and provide a concise completion summary.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and responsive CSS.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, game loop, controls, enemies, scoring, blood effects.
- `screenshots/gameplay.jpg`: Latest inspected gameplay screenshot.

- Local dev server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser is at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `playwright-cli` is installed and browser was installed for visual checks.
- Current work is uncommitted.
